name: droi-workspace
description: Droi: desktop, web and iPhone front ends for the Droid Daemon

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm -C tests exec playwright test -c web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:phone: pnpm -C tests exec playwright test -c mobile/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm -C tests exec playwright test -c electron/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:live: pnpm -C tests exec playwright test -c live/playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:root && pnpm typecheck:desktop && pnpm typecheck:mobile && pnpm typecheck:tests
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
